title: Intake contract frontmatter
description: Flat frontmatter of intake/<yyyymmdd>-<slug>.md (Skill 4). Body: the extracted element table with an extra confidence column, then ## Questions.

source.description: The image path or URL the layout was read from.

source_type.description: How the source was read, which chooses the extraction path (Skill 4).
source_type.$comment: No vocab file yet; enum is inline pending one. Values from docs/PLAN.md §Skill 4.

detected_archetype.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/archetype.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.

detected_family.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/family.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
detected_family.description: Family implied by detected_archetype; must equal its broader in archetype.json.

confidence.description: Extractor confidence in detected_archetype, 0-1. The body element table carries a per-row confidence column.

target_w.description: Target canvas width; Canva presentation pages are 1920x1080 (research/09).

fonts_detected.description: Font families read off the source, spelled as spec/fonts.json spells them where recognised.

fonts_native.description: True when every detected family is Canva-native.

license_note.description: What may be reused from the source. Structure only unless this says otherwise.

brand.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/brand.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
brand.description: Brand the catalogued layout will carry.

status.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/status.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
status.description: Intake lifecycle. Subset of spec/vocab/status.json with broader intake_status. Conversion runs only at confirmed.

open_questions.description: Questions the operator must answer before status can move to confirmed. Mirrored as the body ## Questions list.

layout_id.description: Layout id assigned at catalogue time, or "-".
